# AgendaWeb

> > Free English learning resources featuring grammar exercises, vocabulary practice, printable worksheets, and classic fairy tales by Andersen and Grimms for ESL learners.

AgendaWeb is a comprehensive English as a Second Language (ESL) platform offering interactive exercises, printable PDF worksheets, and reading materials organized by grammar topics, vocabulary themes, and skill levels from beginner to advanced.

## Key Topics

- English Grammar
- ESL Exercises
- Quantifiers (many/much/few/little)
- Countable and Uncountable Nouns
- Grammar Worksheets
- Printable Exercises
- Verb Tenses
- Alphabet and Vowels
- Listening Exercises
- Andersen Fairy Tales
- Grimms Fairy Tales
- Writing Practice
- Beginner English
- Phonics
- Articles (a/an/the)

## Vocabulary Resources

- [Vocabulary Exercises for ESL Learners](https://agendaweb.org/vocabulary-exercises.html): Main vocabulary exercises hub for ESL learners at all levels
- [Worksheets: Places in town - city](https://agendaweb.org/vocabulary/places-city-worksheets.html): Printable PDF worksheets for city vocabulary and giving directions

## Grammar Exercises and Worksheets

- [Verb tenses 2: exercises](https://agendaweb.org/verbs-exercises-2.html): Grammar exercises covering verb tenses and modal verbs
- [Articles: worksheets pdf, printable exercises](https://agendaweb.org/grammar/articles-worksheets-resources.html): Printable PDF worksheets for definite and indefinite articles
- [To have: worksheets, printable exercises pdf, handouts](https://agendaweb.org/verbs/to-have-worksheets-lessons.html): Printable worksheets for 'to have' verb conjugation and have got
- [To be past - worksheets pdf, handouts, printable exercises](https://agendaweb.org/verbs/to-be-past-worksheets-lessons.html): Past tense worksheets for 'to be' (was/were) with printable PDFs

## Quantifiers and Countable/Uncountable Nouns

- [There is much / there are many - 2](https://agendaweb.org/exercises/grammar/countable-uncountable/there-is-much-there-are-many-2.htm): Exercise on quantifiers with countable/uncountable nouns
- [Many / much - write](https://agendaweb.org/exercises/grammar/countable-uncountable/many-much-write.htm): Writing exercise practicing many/much with countable/uncountable nouns
- [Few, a few, little, a little - 3](https://agendaweb.org/exercises/grammar/countable-uncountable/few-little-3.htm): Grammar exercise on few/little quantifiers with nouns
- [A few / a little - test 1](https://agendaweb.org/exercises/grammar/countable-uncountable/few-little-test-1.html): Grammar test on few/little quantifiers with countable/uncountable nouns

## Reading Practice: Fairy Tales

- [Fairy tales - Andersen](https://agendaweb.org/reading/fairy-tales-2.html): Reading practice with Andersen fairy tales like The Ugly Duckling

## Alphabet, Vowels, and Pronunciation

- [Vowels: listen and find](https://agendaweb.org/exercises/grammar/alphabet/vowels-listen-find.htm): Interactive listening exercise for identifying English vowels
- [Vowels: quiz](https://agendaweb.org/exercises/grammar/alphabet/vowels-audio-quiz.htm): Interactive audio quiz testing vowel recognition and pronunciation

## Optional

- [Opposite adjectives - write 2](https://agendaweb.org/exercises/grammar/adjectives/opposite-write-2): Writing exercise practicing antonyms and opposite adjectives
